Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilg.qov.ph DILG OPINION No. 22 s. 2022 APR 18 2022 PUNONG BARANGAY JESSE JAMES A. TING Barangay Maharlika, San Pedro City Laguna Dear PB Ting: This has reference to your letter addressed to Richard Geronimo, Office of Barangay Affairs, regarding the estimated revenues in the total amount of involving seven (7) newly created barangays of San Pedro City, Laguna. At the outset, we would like to stress that Republic Act No. 7160, otherwise known as the "Local Government Code of 1991" (LGC), the general law applicable to all local government units and its local officials, sets the technical and political structure and mode of governance of all local governments, barangays included. Simply stated, the LGC is the basic law which must be considered by all local government units (LGUs) Accordingly, as provided by the last paragraph of Section 285 of the LGC, the fiscal requirement of barangays created by the LGUs after the effectivity of the Code shall be the responsibility of the LGU concerned. Relatedly, under Section 385 and 386 of the LGC, barangays may be created through a law enacted by Congress or through an Ordinance by the Sangguniang Panlalawigan with respect to the creation of new barangays in a municipality, or by the Sangguniang Panglungsod, with respect to the creation of new barangays within a city. In addition, it provides further that the financial requirement of the barangays created by the provincial or city government, shall be the responsibility of the LGU concerned, or the LGU which created the new barangay, as the case may be. However, it is noteworthy to emphasize that a Congressional enactment formally provides for its direct share from its just share in the national taxes provided for in the annual General Appropriations Act. In that regard, this level is of the view that the LGU creating the barangays must bear the financial requirement, and not the mother barangay. The IRA share of the so-called mother barangay is theirs alone and the financial requirements of the newly created barangays after the effectivity of the LGC shall be borne by the creating LGU. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54
